title: American-Style Sausage and Umami Fries
description: A twist on classic fries, topped with savory sausage and umami flavor.

ingredients.name: Flaky potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into fry shapes

instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 180°C.
Fry the potatoes in batches until golden and crispy.
Remove the fries from the oil and season with salt and pepper.
In a separate pan, cook the sausage over medium heat until browned.
Add the umami paste or powder to the sausage and stir-fry for 1 minute.
To assemble, place a portion of fries on a plate, top with cooked sausage and umami sauce.
